Happy 20th birthday to Indonesia's middle-distance runner Mutiara Oktarani, who ran at the SEA Games at 16 and has been collecting medals across Asia ever since.

Medan, 15 November 2025. At the SEA U20 Championships at the Madya Stadium in North Sumatra, Mutiara took silver in the 1500m. It capped a 2025 that had already brought her two national titles: at the Indonesian U20 Championships at Manahan Stadium in Surakarta she won the 1500m on 31 August, then came back the next day to win the 800m in 2:16.07.

This year she has taken her running onto the road. She opened 2026 with a win in January and took another at Planet Sport in February. "Hard work paid off," she wrote. Through the Bank Jateng Young Talent programme at the Borobudur Marathon she has tried the 10K, and in September she lined up at the ASICS Jakarta Speed Race. "Pikiran kuat. Tubuh kuat." Strong mind. Strong body. Her father's advice, as she shared it in April: just run happy and enjoy it.

Her story begins in Seyegan, in Sleman Regency, Yogyakarta. She was spotted after winning at the Sembada Marathon in Sleman in 2016, and by her early teens she had 25 medals and was training around three hours a day. In 2018 she won the 800m and 1500m at the national PPLP championships in Gorontalo. In 2019 she won the 1500m and 5000m at the national championships in Bangka Belitung, then took silver in the 1500m and bronze in the 3000m at the ASEAN School Games in Semarang as the youngest athlete there. In 2020, at 13, she became the youngest member of the national training squad, Pelatnas, in the PB PASI junior programme.

The international medals followed. In 2022 she won gold at the Thailand Open and bronze at the Asian U18 Championships in Kuwait. In May 2023, at 16, she made her senior SEA Games debut at the Morodok Techo National Stadium in Phnom Penh, running a personal best of 2:14.35 for fifth in the 800m and finishing sixth in the 1500m. That December she won 1500m gold at the SEA Youth Championships in Pathum Thani, Thailand, and in April 2024 she ran a 1500m personal best of 4:32.99 for fifth at the Asian U20 Championships in Dubai.

She went to SMA Negeri 1 Seyegan, close to home, and she has a message for anyone wondering whether they belong: "Jangan terlalu memikirkan apakah kamu sudah cukup cepat atau belum. Kalau punya kesempatan, coba saja dulu." Don't think too much about whether you're fast enough yet. If you have the opportunity, just try.
